basin_water.name: Basin Water — a lid of moving water
basin_water.description: One plane in a museum basin, 35 cm under the glass lid, displaced in the vertex shader by three directional sines and a value noise and coloured by the angle it is seen from. Every vertex and pixel is recomputed from the clock on every frame; nothing is stored between frames, and the glass lid, not the water, is what carries the body. The waves are rounded to whole cycles per TIME rollover (30 s in this project) so the clock's wrap never shows. Token keys: width, depth (metres), amplitude, wavelength, speed, noise_amount, lift (default -0.35), calm:on.
interactions: Stand on the lid and watch the surface move under your feet
Walk round the pool and watch the colour follow your angle
Read the desk's amplitude against what the surface does
basin_water.qfep_connection: A surface can answer light, position and time without keeping a memory or having a body; what carries the visitor is a different construction from what they are looking at.
